belief: A missing BOOT_TIME line means boot stalled.
test: Compare later service milestones and runtime-state files across matched physical runs.
result: The later milestones matched even when the console marker did not. A logging-route race is plausible but untraced.
replacement: Use independent progress and response evidence; keep QEMU runs that lacked later milestones unresolved.

belief: The submitted surfaces are zero, so a renderer is missing.
test: Present a known pattern and validate the descriptor read path before classifying the original source.
result: The early read route was ineffective. A mapped-descriptor capture subsequently showed original-client setup pixels.
replacement: Verify the observer and transfer length before drawing conclusions about the source. General GPU coverage remains open.

belief: The radio-present message establishes a modeled radio.
test: Compare the guest detection predicate with the model's actual register responses.
result: An unsupported input defaulted to zero, satisfying the presence predicate despite the absence of a radio model.
replacement: A log message proves a code path. It does not prove the hardware capability named by that path.

belief: A backed physical address rules out a translation problem.
test: Walk the active descriptors and inspect the fault class and interpretation controls.
result: The A53 access-flag interpretation rejected a legacy descriptor even though its physical target was backed RAM.
replacement: Translation, permissions and interpretation must agree before an access is valid.

belief: MACH Reboot means the device reset cleanly.
test: Observe return to recovery and check the complete post-run data image.
result: An earlier printed marker preceded an integration failure. Corrected trials independently established actual recovery return.
replacement: Require the state transition and its postconditions, not merely the log before it.

belief: A black screen is necessarily a display-driver failure.
test: Inspect selected surfaces and backing bytes, then trace the original client's blank request.
result: One QEMU transition was explicitly requested by SpringBoard's dimming path while prior pixels remained intact.
replacement: Separate intentional black, failed presentation, backlight policy and system liveness. Attribute each physical case with its own evidence.

belief: A quiet CPU and a recovery charging label settle the power question.
test: Measure the USB input state during XNU and compare battery readings over a controlled interval.
result: The accepted USB-controller state yielded usable input and net battery gain in the measured configuration.
replacement: Measure the energy path in the target state; idle residency and charging are independent observations.

belief: Two contact records prove a working pinch gesture.
test: Compare the original consumer identities with owner-visible Photos behavior.
result: Two active records collided on one interpreted finger identity; distinct stable identities enabled visible enlargement.
replacement: Packet count, identity semantics and visible gesture acceptance need separate checks.

belief: Thirty display updates per second mean a thirty-frame camera viewfinder.
test: Count native delivery, accepted submissions and distinct selected images separately.
result: The baseline reported about 30.3 panel updates but 7.9 distinct selected images per second.
replacement: Name the boundary each rate measures and retain repeated-image use in the interpretation.

belief: A roughly 99% fall in atomic traps establishes a comparable UI speedup.
test: Run the same physical interaction sequence with the hotspot change off and on.
result: Traps fell sharply; mean frame gaps improved in two windows and worsened in two.
replacement: Report the local overhead improvement; leave application latency and consistent UI benefit unresolved.

belief: The PinePhone cannot provide telephony because it has no baseband.
test: Check the board specification and the profile acceptance boundary.
result: The original PinePhone includes an EG25-G modem. Native telephony integration is unaccepted.
replacement: Classify telephony as planned integration, not absent hardware. A No Service label is not a hardware inventory.

test: Compare actual acquisition and stock destination geometry in the accepted 7E18 route.
result: The source capture is 640 × 480; still output is resampled.
replacement: Distinguish output dimensions from acquired detail; keep genuine higher-detail modes pending.

belief: A fixed 30-second USB delay is sufficient for normal pairing.
test: Execute the measured soft-connect delay and compare complete mux frames, then sample daemon/socket readiness separately.
result: The delayed trial still receives ECONNREFUSED/RST. A later diagnostic first samples the listener 41.237 s after startup, after host preflight.
replacement: Retain the failed candidate and new readiness-ordering explanation. First sample is not exact bind time; pairing and the next listener gate remain pending.

belief: A physical regulator starts in the same state under every loader.
test: Run the identical pre-XNU snapshot through SD U-Boot and eMMC Tow-Boot.
result: The comparison reports inherited differences, including an already enabled supported analog camera rail; dynamic conditions also differ.
replacement: Verify and adopt supported owned state, preserve unowned masks and do not treat programmed selectors as voltage measurements.

belief: An idle 12.7 ms presentation mean establishes animation performance.
test: Count changes and separate work, gap and diagnostic logging samples.
result: The later 64-presentation interval has zero sampled changes; the log has one much larger sample.
replacement: Report idle elapsed timing and instrument scope. Moving UI, pure compositor time and 7E18 Camera FPS remain unmeasured.

belief: Scoped diagnostic success means the original whole-run checker passed.
test: Inspect original runner limits and negative earlier capture/recovery fields.
result: The listener diagnostic/recovery passes while original capture completeness remains false; an earlier snapshot return also failed.
replacement: Publish both verdicts with their scope, rather than upgrading incomplete capture or erasing failed recovery.
